import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
file_path = '/Data2/v-weilinjin/workshop/AttributeBench/benchmarks/GAIA/2023/validation/32102e3e-d12a-4209-9163-7b3a104efe5d.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, skiprows=2)
formats = {'DVD','Blu-Ray','VHS','Digital','CD'}
df['Format'] = np.nan
current = None
for i, t in df['Title'].items():
    t2 = str(t).strip()
    if t2 in formats:
        current = t2
        df.at[i, 'Format'] = current
    else:
        df.at[i, 'Format'] = current
br = df[(df['Format']=='Blu-Ray') & (~df['Title'].isin(formats))].copy()
br['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(br['Year'], errors='coerce')
br = br.dropna(subset=['Year'])
print(br[['Title','Year']].sort_values('Year').to_string(index=False))
